guides-01-overview--docs.title: Guides/01 Overview
guides-01-overview--docs.content: import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # Breeze UI Breeze UI is the React component library used to build Motech Development applications. Its components are accessible, keyboard navigable, and styled for light and dark colour schemes. ## Getting started Add the package and its stylesheet as described in Installation, then set up the provider as described in Usage. ## Components Each component page documents the component's options with interactive examples, and lists its props under API.
guides-01-overview--docs.summary: React components for building Motech Development interfaces.

guides-02-installation--docs.name: Docs
guides-02-installation--docs.title: Guides/02 Installation
guides-02-installation--docs.content: import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # Installation Run the following command to add Breeze UI to your application: ```sh yarn add @motech-development/breeze-ui ``` ## Peer dependencies `react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies. Breeze UI requires React 19. ## Styles Import the stylesheet once, at the entry point of your application: ```tsx import '@motech-development/breeze-ui/styles.css'; ``` ## Reset Breeze UI provides an optional reset for browser default styles. To use it, import it before the stylesheet: ```tsx import '@motech-development/breeze-ui/reset.css'; import '@motech-development/breeze-ui/styles.css'; ``` Next, see Usage to set up the provider.
guides-02-installation--docs.summary: Install the package and import its styles.
